differences.sampling: SAC-centred AR(1), 64/8/4 retained; official planner also has prior-generated trajectories, which are not added here.
differences.terminal_prior: Deterministic squashed prior mean; restores unused sample RNG. This is a reproducibility adaptation to the official stochastic pi terminal action, not an exact stochastic reproduction.
differences.Q: D0/D1/D2 keep official already-decoded random-two avg. D3 fixes one pair per plan. D4 explicitly decodes all-Q logits then averages. Frozen SAC feature reducer unchanged.
differences.temperature: D1 beta=.5 multiplies the value difference; D0 legacy divisor tau=.5 is beta=2.
